issues.description: Method getNameAndTotalNumberOfStudents: the UML in the problem statement (class diagram) declares getNameAndTotalNumberOfStudents() with return type void, but the textual task description in the problem statement says the method should return a String and the solution implementation defines public String getNameAndTotalNumberOfStudents(). This mismatch between the UML and the textual/specification and solution can confuse students about the expected return type and what to implement.
issues.suggestedFix: Update the UML in problem_statement.md to declare getNameAndTotalNumberOfStudents(): String so it matches the textual description and the solution. If the intended design were to return void instead, then update the textual description and the solution/template to reflect void; however prefer changing the UML to String to align with the task instructions and solution.
